id: \rCrystal: My name is Crystal. I've mastered the art of capturing Pokémon and have completed the Pokédex given to me by Professor Oak.
en: \rCrystal: My name is Crystal. I've mastered the art of capturing Pokémon and have completed the Pokédex given to me by Professor Oak.
it: \rCrystal: Mi chiamo Crystal. Padroneggio l'arte di catturare Pokémon e ho completato il Pokédex che mi ha dato il Professor Oak.

id: \rBecause of that I've been given the title Catcher.
en: \rBecause of that I've been given the title Catcher.
it: \rPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Catturatrice.

id: \rCrystal: Do you use different types of balls? Any capture pro needs to take advantage of them.
en: \rCrystal: Do you use different types of balls? Any capture pro needs to take advantage of them.
it: \rCrystal: Usi diversi tipi di Ball? Ogni esperto di catture deve sfruttarle al meglio.
